title: Existence of the normalized difference morphism
statement: For every scheme morphism f, there is an O_X-module morphism from relative differentials to the diagonal conormal whose composite with the universal derivation satisfies the normalized difference formula on all compatible opens and kernel sections.

proof.text: Construct the morphism from the universal relative differential sheaf by the difference of the two splittings of the square-zero diagonal extension; the local kernel calculation gives the displayed normalization.

mathlib_searches.query: sheaf morphism from relative differentials to diagonal conormal

lean.statement: theorem exists_diagonalConormalMorphism (f : X ⟶ S) : ∃ φ : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ diagonalConormal f, ∀ (U : X.Opens) (W : (pullback f f).Opens) (h₁ : W ≤ (pullback.fst f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h₂ : W ≤ (pullback.snd f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hδ : U ≤ (pullback.diagonal f) ⁻¹ᵁ W) (a : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom), W)), (kernel.ι (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app (op W) s = (pullback.snd f f).appLE U W h₂ a - (pullback.fst f f).appLE U W h₁ a → (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp φ.val).d (X := op U) a = (diagonalConormal f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hδ).op (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.diagonal f))).unit.app (kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom))).val.app (op W) s)
